current_scope: Implement future exact200-per-arm/seed runner and guards. Before each gradient probe, the new evaluator replays complete frozen train/validation step0 predictions and statistics against the immutable reference. Public gradient checks use only first16 already frozen train draws per seed/arm;6 backward calls, no optimizer construction/update, cleared gradients and unchanged parameters. Synthetic optimizer/checkpoint unit tests are explicitly fixtures, not a public training run.

future_design.training_entrypoint_status: not_implemented_for_multiepisode_study; old fixed-pair runner must not be repurposed by removing its guards
future_design.sampling: separate CPU torch.Generator per seed; uniform verified training group, then uniform episode within group, then uniform complete window; identical draws shared by both arms
future_design.normalization_and_sampler_hashes: must be materialized and frozen after accepted source/feature pack and before any optimization
future_design.zero_arm_gradient_expectation: action_projection.weight may have exactlyzero gradient when its input is zero; all graph-connected parameter gradients must exist and be finite; global norm must be nonzero; do not require each tensor to be nonzero
future_design.checkpoint: only final200 per arm/seed; same safe save/reload checks, no best-validation selection

training_gate: A separate positive user-approved authorization JSON plus external SHA and --execute-training must bind this plan, passed gradient report and exact1200 future budget. This implementation never creates that authorization. The prospective source plan remains immutable; its historical execution_authorized=false is not edited.
checkpoint: Only final200; old atomic no-overwrite/weights_only primitives retained. Caller-verified expected binding AND full metadata required at load. Old metadata.authorization_sha256 contains canonical arm/seed/provenance binding digest, not original authorization file hash; original is explicit in binding/envelope.
parameter_hashes: Existing step0 parameter_hash retained for frozen random-reference checks; original smoke.parameter_sha retained for native checkpoint metadata. Distinct serialization schemes are never interchanged.
evaluation: New single-arm evaluator reuses unchanged action transform, targets, full support, Totals and macro/micro. Current gradient_check first validates every frozen step0 prediction and statistic for all6 arms on1086/500 windows (624 model prediction batches), with no optimizer; it never calls or overwrites the old step0 runner. Future train repeats this fail-closed check for all6 arms before first optimizer. Final evaluation uses identical input/target hashes, action0 in zero arm, and checkpoint reload model; no checkpoint or seed selection.
recovery: Exclusive new output only. Preserve failure and partial trace/checkpoints; no overwrite, automatic retry, resume, skipped steps or replacement seeds. Failed jobs cannot be counted as completed comparisons.
